verses.arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًۭٔا مَّذْكُورًا
verses.english: Has there been a period of time for man when he was not anything worthy of mention?
verses.transliteration_html: Hal ata AAala alinsani heenun mina alddahri lam yakun shayan mathkooran
verses.transliteration_text: Hal ata AAala alinsani heenun mina alddahri lam yakun shayan mathkooran

verses.arabic: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍۢ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
verses.english: Indeed We created man from the drop of a mixed fluid so that We may put him to test, so We endowed with hearing and sight.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna khalaqna alinsana min nutfatin amshajin nabtaleehi fajaAAalnahu sameeAAan baseeran
verses.transliteration_text: Inna khalaqna alinsana min nutfatin amshajin nabtaleehi fajaAAalnahu sameeAAan baseeran

verses.arabic: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًۭا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
verses.english: Indeed We have guided him to the way, be he grateful or ungrateful.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna hadaynahu alssabeela imma shakiran waimma kafooran
verses.transliteration_text: Inna hadaynahu alssabeela imma shakiran waimma kafooran

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَلَـٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَـٰلًۭا وَسَعِيرًا
verses.english: Indeed for the faithless We have prepared chains, iron collars, and a blaze.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna aAAtadna lilkafireena salasila waaghlalan wasaAAeeran
verses.transliteration_text: Inna aAAtadna lilkafireena salasila waaghlalan wasaAAeeran

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍۢ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
verses.english: Indeed the pious will drink from a cup seasoned with Kafur,
verses.transliteration_html: Inna alabrara yashraboona min kasin kana mizajuha kafooran
verses.transliteration_text: Inna alabrara yashraboona min kasin kana mizajuha kafooran

verses.arabic: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًۭا
verses.english: a spring where Allah’s servants will drink, making it gush forth as they please.
verses.transliteration_html: AAaynan yashrabu biha AAibadu Allahi yufajjiroonaha tafjeeran
verses.transliteration_text: AAaynan yashrabu biha AAibadu Allahi yufajjiroonaha tafjeeran

verses.arabic: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًۭا
verses.english: They fulfill their vows and fear a day whose ill will be widespread.
verses.transliteration_html: Yoofoona bialnnathri wayakhafoona yawman kana sharruhu mustateeran
verses.transliteration_text: Yoofoona bialnnathri wayakhafoona yawman kana sharruhu mustateeran

verses.arabic: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًۭا وَيَتِيمًۭا وَأَسِيرًا
verses.english: For the love of Him, they feed the needy, the orphan and the prisoner,
verses.transliteration_html: WayutAAimona alttaAAama AAala hubbihi miskeenan wayateeman waaseeran
verses.transliteration_text: WayutAAimona alttaAAama AAala hubbihi miskeenan wayateeman waaseeran

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَلَا شُكُورًا
verses.english: [saying,] ‘We feed you only for the sake of Allah. We desire no reward from you, nor thanks.
verses.transliteration_html: Innama nutAAimukum liwajhi Allahi la nureedu minkum jazaan wala shukooran
verses.transliteration_text: Innama nutAAimukum liwajhi Allahi la nureedu minkum jazaan wala shukooran

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًۭا قَمْطَرِيرًۭا
verses.english: Indeed we fear a frowning and fateful day from our Lord.’
verses.transliteration_html: Inna nakhafu min rabbina yawman AAaboosan qamtareeran
verses.transliteration_text: Inna nakhafu min rabbina yawman AAaboosan qamtareeran

verses.arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةًۭ وَسُرُورًۭا
verses.english: So Allah saved them from that day’s ills and graced them with freshness [on this faces] and joy [in their hearts].
verses.transliteration_html: Fawaqahumu Allahu sharra thalika alyawmi walaqqahum nadratan wasurooran
verses.transliteration_text: Fawaqahumu Allahu sharra thalika alyawmi walaqqahum nadratan wasurooran

verses.arabic: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةًۭ وَحَرِيرًۭا
verses.english: He rewarded them for their patience with a garden and [garments of] silk,
verses.transliteration_html: Wajazahum bima sabaroo jannatan wahareeran
verses.transliteration_text: Wajazahum bima sabaroo jannatan wahareeran

verses.arabic: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًۭا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًۭا
verses.english: reclining therein on couches, without facing any [scorching] sun, or [biting] cold.
verses.transliteration_html: Muttakieena feeha AAala alaraiki la yarawna feeha shamsan wala zamhareeran
verses.transliteration_text: Muttakieena feeha AAala alaraiki la yarawna feeha shamsan wala zamhareeran

verses.arabic: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَـٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًۭا
verses.english: Its shades will be close over them and its clusters [of fruits] will be hanging low.
verses.transliteration_html: Wadaniyatan AAalayhim thilaluha wathullilat qutoofuha tathleelan
verses.transliteration_text: Wadaniyatan AAalayhim thilaluha wathullilat qutoofuha tathleelan

verses.arabic: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍۢ مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
verses.english: They will be served around with vessels of silver and goblets of crystal
verses.transliteration_html: Wayu<u>ta</u>fu AAalayhim bi<u>a</u>niyatin min fi<u>dd</u>atin waakw<u>a</u>bin k<u>a</u>nat qaw<u>a</u>reer<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Wayutafu AAalayhim bianiyatin min fiddatin waakwabin kanat qawareera

verses.arabic: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًۭا
verses.english: —crystal of silver— [from] which they will dispense in a precise measure.
verses.transliteration_html: Qawareera min fiddatin qaddarooha taqdeeran
verses.transliteration_text: Qawareera min fiddatin qaddarooha taqdeeran

verses.arabic: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
verses.english: They will be served therein with a cup of a drink seasoned with Zanjabeel,
verses.transliteration_html: Wayusqawna feeha kasan kana mizajuha zanjabeelan
verses.transliteration_text: Wayusqawna feeha kasan kana mizajuha zanjabeelan

verses.arabic: عَيْنًۭا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًۭا
verses.english: from a spring in it named Salsabeel.
verses.transliteration_html: AAaynan feeha tusamma salsabeelan
verses.transliteration_text: AAaynan feeha tusamma salsabeelan

verses.arabic: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًۭا مَّنثُورًۭا
verses.english: They will be waited upon by immortal youths, whom, were you to see them, you will suppose them to be scattered pearls.
verses.transliteration_html: Wayatoofu AAalayhim wildanun mukhalladoona itha raaytahum hasibtahum luluan manthooran
verses.transliteration_text: Wayatoofu AAalayhim wildanun mukhalladoona itha raaytahum hasibtahum luluan manthooran

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًۭا وَمُلْكًۭا كَبِيرًا
verses.english: As you look on, you will see there bliss and a great kingdom.
verses.transliteration_html: Waitha raayta thamma raayta naAAeeman wamulkan kabeeran
verses.transliteration_text: Waitha raayta thamma raayta naAAeeman wamulkan kabeeran

verses.arabic: عَـٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌۭ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌۭ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًۭا طَهُورًا
verses.english: Upon them will be cloaks of green silk and brocade and they will be adorned with bracelets of silver. Their Lord will give them to drink a pure drink.
verses.transliteration_html: AAaliyahum thiyabu sundusin khudrun waistabraqun wahulloo asawira min fiddatin wasaqahum rabbuhum sharaban tahooran
verses.transliteration_text: AAaliyahum thiyabu sundusin khudrun waistabraqun wahulloo asawira min fiddatin wasaqahum rabbuhum sharaban tahooran

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
verses.english: [They will be told]: ‘This is your reward, and your efforts have been well-appreciated.’
verses.transliteration_html: Inna hatha kana lakum jazaan wakana saAAyukum mashkooran
verses.transliteration_text: Inna hatha kana lakum jazaan wakana saAAyukum mashkooran

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًۭا
verses.english: Indeed We have sent down to you the Quran in a gradual descent.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna nahnu nazzalna AAalayka alqurana tanzeelan
verses.transliteration_text: Inna nahnu nazzalna AAalayka alqurana tanzeelan

verses.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًۭا
verses.english: So submit patiently to the judgement of your Lord and do not obey any sinner or ingrate from among them,
verses.transliteration_html: Faisbir lihukmi rabbika wala tutiAA minhum athiman aw kafooran
verses.transliteration_text: Faisbir lihukmi rabbika wala tutiAA minhum athiman aw kafooran

verses.arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًۭا
verses.english: and celebrate the Name of your Lord morning and evening,
verses.transliteration_html: Waothkuri isma rabbika bukratan waaseelan
verses.transliteration_text: Waothkuri isma rabbika bukratan waaseelan

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًۭا طَوِيلًا
verses.english: and worship Him for a watch of the night and glorify Him the night long.
verses.transliteration_html: Wamina allayli faosjud lahu wasabbihhu laylan taweelan
verses.transliteration_text: Wamina allayli faosjud lahu wasabbihhu laylan taweelan

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًۭا ثَقِيلًۭا
verses.english: Indeed they love this transitory life, and disregard a heavy day that is ahead of them.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna haolai yuhibboona alAAajilata wayatharoona waraahum yawman thaqeelan
verses.transliteration_text: Inna haolai yuhibboona alAAajilata wayatharoona waraahum yawman thaqeelan

verses.arabic: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
verses.english: We created them and strengthened their joints, and We will replace them with others like them whenever We like.
verses.transliteration_html: Nahnu khalaqnahum washadadna asrahum waitha shina baddalna amthalahum tabdeelan
verses.transliteration_text: Nahnu khalaqnahum washadadna asrahum waitha shina baddalna amthalahum tabdeelan

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا
verses.english: This is indeed a reminder. So let anyone who wishes take the way toward his Lord.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna hathihi tathkiratun faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeelan
verses.transliteration_text: Inna hathihi tathkiratun faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeelan

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا
verses.english: But you will not wish unless it is willed by Allah. Indeed Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama tashaoona illa an yashaa Allahu inna Allaha kana AAaleeman hakeeman
verses.transliteration_text: Wama tashaoona illa an yashaa Allahu inna Allaha kana AAaleeman hakeeman

verses.arabic: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
verses.english: He admits whomever He wishes into His mercy, and He has prepared a painful punishment for the wrongdoers.
verses.transliteration_html: Yudkhilu man yashao fee rahmatihi waalththalimeena aAAadda lahum AAathaban aleeman
verses.transliteration_text: Yudkhilu man yashao fee rahmatihi waalththalimeena aAAadda lahum AAathaban aleeman
